english.title: Relinquished possession of object subject of section 4 notice before specified date - chemical weapon
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been previously served with a copy of a notice under section 4 of the Chemical Weapons Act 1996 by the Secretary of State in relation to an object, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OBJECT..), which was in your possession without reasonable excuse, you relinquished possession of it prior to the date specified in the notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 9(1) and (4) of the Chemical Weapons Act 1996.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
